title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace warning: true study-level vs. storefront traps!
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the landmines on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a massive wave of recent Marketplace releases that represent both the absolute best and the absolute worst of flight simulation addons.

We dive deep into high-fidelity heavy hitters like the highly anticipated, feature-rich Black Square Caravan Professional series, making its 2024 debut with NASA-backed failure logic, pristine Boris Audio Works sounds, and true systems depth. We also look at unique flight experiences like Arantis Simulations' experimental twin-engine Dedalus BS 214 and Skyward Simulations' promising Citation Sovereign+.

On the flip side, the storefront has been completely flooded by an avalanche of "Enhanced Editions" from MScenery alongside heavily criticized airliners that are currently tanking in the reviews. From missing cockpit screenshots to recycled default assets, we expose the deceptive storefront tactics of developers like Captain Sim and RM Studios to show you exactly where your hard-earned money is best spent.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know what's in your hangar!
